description_en: Obtains the auto scaling settings of a cluster
description_zh: 调用GetAutoScaleConfig获取指定集群的自动伸缩配置信息
name: GetAutoScaleConfig

ClusterId.description_en: The prefix of the queue name. You can query queues that have a specified prefix

ClusterType.description_zh:
集群的调度器类型。可能值：
slurm
pbs
opengridscheduler
deadline

ComputeEnableHt.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable hyper-threading for the ECS instance that is used as the compute node.

You can only disable hyper-threading for some instance types. The hyper-threading is enabled for ECS instances by default. For more information, see [Specify and view CPU options]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145895.html）
ComputeEnableHt.description_zh: 计算节点对应的ECS实例是否开启超线程

EnableAutoGrow.description_en:
The percentage of each round of scale-out. Valid values: 1 to 100.

If you set GrowRatio to 50, the scale-out has two rounds. Each round completes half of the scale-out
EnableAutoGrow.description_zh:
集群是否启动自动扩容。可能值：
true
false

EnableAutoShrink.description_en:
The number of consecutive times that a compute node is idle during the resource scale-in check. Valid values: 2 to 5.

If the parameter is set to 3, a compute node is idle for more than three consecutive times. In this case, the node is released
EnableAutoShrink.description_zh:
集群是否启动自动缩容。可能值：
true
false

ExcludeNodes.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
ExcludeNodes.description_zh: 不参与自动伸缩的节点列表，多个节点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开

ExtraNodesGrowRatio.description_en: The instance type of the compute nodes that were automatically added in the queue
ExtraNodesGrowRatio.description_zh:
额外节点百分比。可能值：0~100

如果作业负载需要新增100个计算节点，ExtraNodesGrowRatio值为2，那么最终新增数量为102

GrowIntervalInMinutes.description_en: The image ID of the compute nodes in the queue
GrowIntervalInMinutes.description_zh:
扩容时间间隔，每轮计算节点扩容的时间间隔。单位：分钟，可能值：2~10

一次扩容任务可能会分几次完成，或者连续触发扩容时的时间间隔

GrowRatio.description_en: The minimum number of compute nodes that can be retained in a queue. Valid values: 0 to 50
GrowRatio.description_zh:
扩容比例。可能值：1~100

如果作业负载需要新增10个计算节点，GrowRatio配置为50，那么会进行多轮扩容，每轮扩容当前所需的50%

GrowTimeoutInMinutes.description_en: The maximum hourly price of the compute nodes. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. The parameter takes effect only when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
GrowTimeoutInMinutes.description_zh:
扩容超时时间，等待启动节点的超时时间。单位：分钟，可能值：10~60

如果扩容时间大于扩容超时时间，节点依然未达到运行状态，系统将此节点释放

ImageId.description_en:
The preemption policy of the compute nodes. Valid values:

NoSpot: The compute nodes are pay-as-you-go instances.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The compute nodes are preemptible instances that have a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The compute nodes are preemptible instances for which the market price at the time of purchase is used as the bid price

MaxNodesInCluster.description_en:
The interval between two consecutive rounds of scale-in. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 2 to 10.

An interval may exist during multiple rounds of a scale-out task or between two consecutive scale-out tasks
MaxNodesInCluster.description_zh: 集群最多可以扩容的节点数量。可能值：0~500

QueueInfo.description_en:
The auto scaling configuration of the queue.

If auto scaling is enabled for the cluster and queue at the same time, the queue settings prevail
QueueInfo.description_zh:
集群队列的自动伸缩配置信息。
集群和队列同时开启了扩容或缩容时，则以队列设置为优先

AutoMinNodesPerCycle.description_en: Indicates whether the minimum node number for each scale-out is automatically set. If this parameter is set to true, the minimum number of nodes for each scale-out is equal to the number of nodes required by the job. The maximum number is 99
AutoMinNodesPerCycle.description_zh:
自动设置单轮扩容的最小节点数量。
如果设置为true，则每次扩容的最小节点数等于作业所需的节点数量，上限是99台

DataDisksInfo.description_zh: 节点上挂载的数据盘信息列表

DataDiskCategory.description_en:
The type of the data disk. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: ESSD.
cloud: basic disk
DataDiskCategory.description_zh:
第N个该节点挂载的数据盘类型。可能值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘

cloud_ssd：SSD云盘

cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

cloud：普通云盘

DataDiskDeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the data disk is released when the node is released. Valid values:

true
false
DataDiskDeleteWithInstance.description_zh:
第N个该节点挂载的数据盘是否随实例释放。可能值：

true：是

false：否

DataDiskEncrypted.description_en:
Indicates whether the data disk is encrypted. Valid values:

true
false
DataDiskEncrypted.description_zh:
第N个该节点的数据盘是否加密。可能值：

true：是

false：否

DataDiskKMSKeyId.description_en: The ID of the KMS key that is used by the data disk
DataDiskKMSKeyId.description_zh: 第N个该节点的数据盘使用的KMS密钥ID

DataDiskPerformanceLevel.description_en:
The performance level of the ESSD used as the data disk. The parameter is returned only when the DataDisks.N.DataDiskCategory parameter is set to cloud_essd. Valid values:

PL0: An ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: An ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: An ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: An ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS
DataDiskPerformanceLevel.description_zh:
第N个该节点的数据盘类型为ESSD云盘时，区分性能等级。仅当DataDisks.N.DataDiskCategory=cloud_essd时返回该参数。可能值：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

DataDiskSize.description_en:
The capacity of the data disk. Unit: GB.

Valid values: 40 to 500
DataDiskSize.description_zh:
第N个该节点挂载的数据盘容量大小。单位：GB

可能值：40~500

EnableAutoGrow.description_en:
Indicates whether the queue enabled the auto scale-out. Valid values:

true
false
EnableAutoGrow.description_zh:
队列是否启动自动扩容。可能值：
true
false

EnableAutoShrink.description_en:
Indicates whether the queue enabled the auto scale-in. Valid values:

true
false
EnableAutoShrink.description_zh:
队列是否启动自动缩容。可能值：
true
false

HostNamePrefix.description_en: The prefix of the queue name. You can query queues that have a specified prefix
HostNamePrefix.description_zh: 队列名前缀。方便您查询具有指定前缀的队列

HostNameSuffix.description_en: The suffix of the queue name. You can query queues that have a specified suffix
HostNameSuffix.description_zh: 队列名后缀。方便您查询具有指定后缀的队列

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the compute nodes that are automatically added to the queue
InstanceType.description_zh: 该队列自动扩容的节点规格

InstanceTypeInfo.description_en: The specification information of the compute nodes

HostNamePrefix.description_en: The prefix of the hostname. You can query compute nodes that have a specified prefix
HostNamePrefix.description_zh: 主机名前缀。方便您查询具有指定前缀的节点

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the compute nodes

SpotDuration.description_en: The protection period of the preemptible instance. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0 to 1. Default value: 1. A value of 0 means no protection period is specified
SpotDuration.description_zh: 抢占式实例的保护期，单位为小时。取值为0~1，默认为1，设置为0表示无保护期

SpotInterruptionBehavior.description_en: The interruption event of the preemptible instance. The value can only be Terminate, which specifies that the instance is released
SpotInterruptionBehavior.description_zh: 抢占实例中断模式。目前仅支持Terminate（默认）直接释放实例
SpotInterruptionBehavior.title_en:
The maximum number of compute nodes that can be added in each round of an auto scale-out task. Valid values: 0 to 99.

Default value: 0.
SpotInterruptionBehavior.title_zh: 抢占实例中断模式。目前仅支持Terminate（默认）直接释放实例。

SpotPriceLimit.description_en: The maximum hourly price of the compute nodes. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is valid only when the SpotStrategy parameter is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
SpotPriceLimit.description_zh: 计算节点每小时最高价格，支持最多3位小数。参数SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The bidding method of the compute nodes. Valid values:

NoSpot: The compute nodes are pay-as-you-go instances.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The compute nodes are preemptible instances that have a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The compute nodes are preemptible instances for which the market price at the time of purchase is used as the bid price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
计算节点竞价策略。可能值：
NoSpot：正常按量付费节点。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式节点。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式节点

VSwitchId.description_zh: 计算节点所属的交换机ID

ZoneId.description_zh: 计算节点所属的可用区ID

MaxNodesInQueue.description_en: The maximum number of compute nodes that can be added to a queue. Valid values: 0 to 500
MaxNodesInQueue.description_zh: 单个队列最多可以扩容的节点数量。可能值：0~500

MaxNodesPerCycle.description_en:
The maximum number of compute nodes that can be added in each round of scale-out. Valid values: 0 to 99.

Default value: 0
MaxNodesPerCycle.description_zh:
自动伸缩每轮扩容的最大计算节点数。取值范围：0~99。

默认值：0

MinNodesInQueue.description_en: The minimum number of compute nodes that can be retained in a queue. Valid values: 0 to 50
MinNodesInQueue.description_zh: 单个队列最小计算节点数，队列最少可以保留的计算节点数量。可能值：0~50

MinNodesPerCycle.description_en:
The minimum number of compute nodes that can be added in each round of scale-out. Valid values: 1 to 99

Default value: 1.

If the compute nodes that you want to add in a round is less than the minimum compute nodes that can be added, the value of this parameter is automatically changed to the number of compute nodes that you want to add. This ensures that compute nodes can be added as expected.

The configuration takes effect only for the minimum compute nodes that can be added in the current round
MinNodesPerCycle.description_zh:
自动伸缩每轮扩容的最小计算节点数。取值范围：1~99。

默认值：1。

如果某一轮次需扩容节点数量小于所设置的最小计算节点数，自动伸缩为保证资源的正常交付，会将该轮次的最小计算节点数自动调整为当前轮次需要扩容节点数量。

该调整仅对当前轮次的最小计算节点数生效

QueueImageId.description_en: The image ID of the compute node in the queue

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the compute nodes belong
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 计算节点所属的资源组ID

SortedByInventory.description_en:
Indicates whether the instances are unordered. Valid values:

true
false

If this parameter is set to true, the system selects instance types in descending order based on the number of instances in stock during auto scaling
SortedByInventory.description_zh:
实例是否支持乱序排列，取值范围：

true：是

false：否

如果设置为true，自动伸缩会按照实例库存数量从多到少的顺序选择实例规格，尽力交付实例资源

SpotPriceLimit.description_en: The maximum hourly price of the compute nodes. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is valid only when the SpotStrategy parameter is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
SpotPriceLimit.description_zh: 计算节点每小时最高价格，支持最大3位小数。参数SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The preemption policy of the compute nodes. Valid values:

NoSpot: The compute nodes are pay-as-you-go instances.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The compute nodes are preemptible instances that have a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The compute nodes are preemptible instances for which the market price at the time of purchase is used as the bid price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
计算节点的抢占策略。可能值：
NoSpot：正常按量付费节点。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式节点。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式节点

SystemDiskCategory.description_en:
The category of the system disk. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: enhanced SSD (ESSD).
cloud: basic disk
SystemDiskCategory.description_zh:
系统盘类型。可能值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
cloud：普通云盘

SystemDiskLevel.description_en:
The performance level of the system disk. Valid values:

PL0: An ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: An ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: An ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: An ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS
SystemDiskLevel.description_zh:
系统盘性能等级。可能值：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万

PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万

PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS10万

PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

SystemDiskSize.description_en: The system disk size. Unit: GB. Valid values: 40 to 500
SystemDiskSize.description_zh: 系统盘大小。单位：GB，可能值：40~500

RequestId.description_en: The image ID of the compute nodes in the queue

ShrinkIdleTimes.description_en: The suffix of the queue name. You can query queues that have a specified suffix
ShrinkIdleTimes.description_zh:
节点连续空闲（未运行作业）次数。节点收缩检查时，一个节点连续处于空闲状态的次数。可能值：2~5

如果该参数值为3，表示一个计算节点连续空闲超过3次，就会被释放

ShrinkIntervalInMinutes.description_en:
The auto scaling configuration of the queue.

If auto scaling is enabled for the cluster and queue at the same time, the queue settings prevail
ShrinkIntervalInMinutes.description_zh: 缩容时间间隔，每轮计算节点收缩的时间间隔。单位：分钟，可能值：2~10

SpotPriceLimit.description_en:
The type of the system disk. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk
cloud_ssd: SSD
cloud_essd: ESSD
cloud: basic disk
SpotPriceLimit.description_zh: 计算节点每小时最高价格，最多支持3位小数。参数SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The percentage of extra compute nodes. Valid values: 0 to 100.

If you need to add 100 compute nodes and the value of the ExtraNodesGrowRatio parameter is 2, 102 compute nodes are added
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
计算节点抢占策略。可能值：
NoSpot：正常按量付费节点。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式节点。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式节点

Uid.description_en: The size of the system disk. Unit: GB. Valid values: 40 to 500
